thread:
Asha (ML): Quick update: ran FP8 canary 48h on production sample. Cost down ~24%, p99 latency +3ms, but NER recall dropped ~1.8% for Spanish named entities.
Marco L.: any pattern on prompt length or token types?
Asha (ML): concentrated on rare entities and inflected forms. Short prompts (<128) mostly fine; issues increase >1024 context.
Priya K.: repeated across seeds / shards? Could be layer-local quant noise.
Asha (ML): same cluster of fails across runs; traced to attention scale in layers 20-22.
Ravi S.: can we surface per-token logits/entropy to trigger fallback heuristics?
Asha (ML): yes 1 we logged tokenwise confidence and per-token delta vs FP32. Quick plot: https://redwood.internal/quant/plots/1654321987 (internal).
Marco L.: proposal: runtime micro-fallback to INT8 when token KL or top-prob drops exceed threshold. Cheaper than FP32 fallback.
Priya K.: agree. Expose conservative signal: if avg token-KL > X or top-token drop > Y in first N tokens, reroute. Keep thresholds loose for now.
Asha (ML): prototype shows token-kl=0.12 catches ~85% of cases; INT8 fallback cost ~+6% on those requests. Net still wins.
Ravi S.: API + routing: (1) client precision hint, (2) runtime-only decision. Which?
Priya K.: both. Client hint for apps that require exactness; runtime for opportunistic safety. Keep public surface small.
Marco L.: suggest header: precision_hint: prefer|balance|quality, default balance. Runtime can trigger fallback only if header allows.
Asha (ML): SDK example: {"precision_hint":"balance","max_extra_cost_percent":"10"}
Ravi S.: need per-customer SLA overrides so fallbacks respect latency commitments.
Priya K.: add `precision_allowlist` and ability to disable runtime fallbacks per customer. Also telemetry flags for canary cohorts.
Asha (ML): rollout plan: 1% canary with header=balance; monitor NER recall and drift for 72h; expand if <2% regression.
Marco L.: long-term: design typed precision_profile proto (per-layer hints, token gating). Short-term header is backwards-compatible.
Priya K.: will draft SDK README and privacy note.
deploy-bot: rollout started: canary job 24321 created.
Asha (ML): actions: Ravi add token-kl metric (ETA 2d); Marco prototype runtime gating (ETA 4d); Priya draft SDK changes (ETA 3d); Ill run expanded canary after hooks land.
Ravi S.: logging quant.token_kl_delta and adding dashboard.
Marco L.: prototyping fallback as middleware to hot-toggle. Reusing routing policy code.
Priya K.: will circulate examples and logging warnings.
Asha (ML): reconvene in 5 days for canary readout. Ping here or @eng-oncall if regressions.
Marco L.: :thumbsup:
